verdict.rationale: Supabase's first-party full-text search guide documents running full-text search directly in the project's Postgres database, a 'search engine within Postgres', with no external search service. It covers to_tsvector/to_tsquery usage, match operators, and search-column indexing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of full-text search in practice, and no evidence on how search is exposed through the auto-generated client/REST APIs.
